page_title: ALA 1-2 RAY | Alaves v Rayo Vallecano 23/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
90+4' The referee Jesus Manzano awards Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) a yellow card.
90+2' Angel Perez (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90' 1 - 2 Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the bottom right corner.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' We are about to witness a substitution. Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) is replacing Ivan Balliu.
87' Yellow card! It's like Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Jesus Manzano agrees and books him.
84' Quique Sanchez Flores prepares a substitution. Jon Guridi is replaced by Ander Guevara (Alaves).
84' It will be a substitution. Ibrahim Diabate (Alaves) is ready to enter the pitch as Lucas Boye walks off.
82' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rayo Vallecano.
80' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
80' The attendance is 17276.
79' A yellow card for a tackle by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves). Jesus Manzano doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
79' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' A great run by Toni Martinez (Alaves) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Alaves will take a corner.
74' The referee signals a substitution. Denis Suarez (Alaves) is brought on as a substitute for Pablo Ibanez.
74' The referee blows for a cooling break.
73' 1 - 1 Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!

73' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
72' Corner kick. Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) is ready to send the ball into the box.
69' Angel Perez (Alaves) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
66' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
64' Jesus Manzano shows the yellow card to Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) for a heavy challenge.
62' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' Here comes a substitution. Abdul Mumin is given a rest as he is replaced by Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano).
61' Inigo Perez has decided to substitute Oscar Valentin and he is replaced by Alemao (Rayo Vallecano).
60' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
60' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

59' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Alaves.
59' Alaves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
57' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
55' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
54' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) sees a yellow card from Jesus Manzano after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
51' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle after Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.

50' That didn't go as planned! Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Antonio Sivera, who easily kept it out.
47' The linesman signals that Toni Martinez (Alaves) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Inigo Perez probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano). He is replaced by Jorge de Frutos.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+2' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jesus Manzano with no other option than to blow for a foul.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
43' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) comes close as his long-range free kick goes a whisker over the crossbar.
41' Poor challenge! Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) is penalised for tripping and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle. Rayo Vallecano win a free kick.

40' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
39' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
38' Inigo Perez is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) suffers an injury and Sergio Camello comes on.
34' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
33' Quique Sanchez Flores is forced to make a change. Victor Parada is unable to continue due to injury, Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) comes on.

33' A dangerous attempt from Toni Martinez (Alaves) was aimed towards the roof of the net, but Dani Cardenas pulls off a superb save and stops this one. The referee blows his whistle, Alaves are awarded a corner kick.
30' Victor Parada (Alaves) picks up an injury.
28' Lucas Boye (Alaves) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
28' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for holding. Jesus Manzano signals a set piece. Alaves earn a free kick.
27' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
25' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
24' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.

20' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
19' Ville Koski (Alaves) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Rayo Vallecano win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
16' Angel Perez (Alaves) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jesus Manzano stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
13' 1 - 0 Toni Martinez (Alaves) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.
12' A corner kick by Rayo Vallecano is thwarted by the well prepared Antonio Sivera (Alaves). Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

11' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Antonio Sivera stops the ball out of the bottom right corner. The ball is out of play and Rayo Vallecano manage to earn a corner.
8' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
6' A pass from Antonio Blanco (Alaves) is intercepted by Dani Cardenas and the move breaks down.
3' The Alaves players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Alaves will have the kick-off.
Jesus Manzano got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
